description:
The 3D handlebar plaque brings the fun of Paw Patrol to every ride! With Chase, Marshall, Skye, and Rubble along for the adventure, little riders will feel like heroes as they cruise the neighborhood.
The fully enclosed chainguard keeps little legs and fingers protected while adding extra fun to every ride. With bright Paw Patrol graphics, kids can pedal alongside their favorite rescue pups in style and safety.
Soft, easy-to-hold grips with fun paw-print designs help little hands stay comfortable and in control. With built-in safety bumpers on the ends, these handlebars are ready for every adventure.
The sturdy steel frame is made to handle every adventure, from backyard rides to neighborhood patrols. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, it’s built for endless fun with Chase, Rubble, and the whole Paw Patrol crew.
The quick-release seatpost makes it easy to adjust the height for the perfect fit as your child grows. Paired with a padded saddle featuring Paw Patrol graphics, every ride is comfy, fun, and built to last.

components.description: Comfort & Safety First: A padded saddle, easy coaster brake, and fully enclosed chain guard keep kids comfortable and protected.
